crossRefs.note: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you…
But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all…
Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all…
When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold…
Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to…
the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold…
It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,
so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud.
translations.bsb: And as Aaron was speaking to the whole congregation of Israel, they looked toward the desert, and there in a cloud the glory of the LORD appeared.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of Jehovah appeared in the cloud.
